killRules.C1: The claim dies if the v19 selftest does not all-pass; any kill receipt shows a surviving mutant; the diff audit names a differing logic line outside the declared change set (a)-(e); the meter stays red after 2 correction cycles; the only path to green is editing a ledger row to match bytes not at the rebind snapshot head; a findings-term drop survives the harness guard (N1 not actually killed); an orphan or unscreened-file line row passes (N4 not actually killed); or a newly screened lane's line row cites bytes not at the snapshot head.
killRules.C2: The claim dies if the counter is green on anything but the committed receipt (synthetic-green; the D2 step-plan check and the D1 page-vs-block cross-check are the implementing checks — a forged-but-consistent receipt that still greens is a kill); the driver sha does not match the freeze pin; a CapsLock or swallow witness rests on driver-side state instead of page/server state (a forged page keylog must trip the D1 cross-check); the keylog lacks the latch sequence (false -> true -> held across the letters -> false) with getModifierState('CapsLock') recorded on the post-latch keystrokes; more than one submission reaches either form's endpoint (exactly one /echo AND exactly one /echo2); or the D4 positive control is absent (form2's Ctrl+Enter must submit).
